title: GroupMemberRecord
description: One row of the group_members table as surfaced by the API (ADR-0004 decision 3). `subject` is always a user subject ('issuer:sub') — never a group id (no nesting). `active` is derived from `removed_at` (empty string == active); membership changes are instant access changes, so removal is soft and audited rather than deleted.

group_id.description: Id of the group this membership belongs to.

subject.description: Resolved subject ('issuer:sub') of the member user.

added_by.description: Subject that added the member (the group owner or an admin).

removed_by.description: Subject that removed the member; empty string while active.

removed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of removal; empty string while active.

active.description: True when the membership has not been removed (`removed_at` is empty).
